privileged_info_for_vlm: The simulation must use PySAM.Pvwattsv8 with a 50,000 kW DC capacity. For Phoenix TMY data with 1-axis tracking and 14% losses, the annual_energy_kwh should fall between 90,000,000 and 125,000,000 kWh. Peak hourly generation in the matrix (typically mid-day in summer months) should be approximately 20,000 kW or higher. The output file must be exactly /home/ga/Documents/SAM_Projects/12x24_profile.json.
